children: The online tranche of Chinese AI chipmaker Shanghai Enflame Technology's (688801.SS) Shanghai initial public offering was oversubscribed by about 6,109 times, triggering a clawback mechanism, an exchange filing showed on Wednesday.
After about 3.4 million shares were moved from the offline tranche to online, the final lot-winning rate in the online tranche - mainly for retail investors - was 0.025%, the filing showed.
